sources.title: Marysville Municipal Code Chapter 16.08 Plumbing Code
sources.supports: Adopts 2021 UPC for plumbing, drainage, fixtures and water heating and treating equipment; amended fee table lists unit items for each water heater and/or vent, gas piping systems, water piping alterations. (Fee amounts not used.)

sources.title: City of Marysville Online Permit and Licensing Portal
sources.supports: Residential plumbing, mechanical, electrical permit types; inspection requests online by 3:30 PM for next business day; MSVLpermits@marysvillewa.gov, 360-363-8223; fraud alert: no wire transfer payments; contractor and permit search.

sources.title: City of Marysville - Building Services
sources.supports: Reviews/inspects for building, plumbing, mechanical codes and newly added electrical permit processing; all building permit applications via Permit Portal.

sources.title: City of Marysville - Permit Services
sources.supports: Fully online permit portal with real-time status; Permit Tech MsvlPermits@marysvillewa.gov / 360.363.8223.

sources.title: City of Marysville - Exempted Work (2021 IBC)
sources.supports: Exempt structures list; separate plumbing, electrical, mechanical permits may be required; call 360-363-8100 to verify.

sources.title: Washington L&I - City Electrical Permits & Inspections
sources.supports: Marysville listed as a city issuing its own electrical permits, 80 Columbia Avenue, 360-363-8231; address lookup for city vs county.

sources.title: Washington L&I - About the Plumber Program
sources.supports: Only L&I-certified plumbers can legally perform plumbing work on someone else's property; owners can do their own.

sources.title: Washington L&I - Plumber Certification
sources.supports: Water heaters listed among plumbing systems covered by certification.

sources.title: RCW 18.106.150 Exemptions
sources.supports: No license required for plumbing at own residence/property; householder may receive unpaid help from non-trade friend/relative.
